name: SudokuPress — Sudoku Puzzle Book Generator with Proven Unique Solutions & Difficulty Bands, Print-Ready PDF (Local)
description:
How do I generate a Sudoku book with proven unique solutions and real difficulty bands, instead of random givens and an answer key built on hope? Hope is how a "Hard" puzzle ends up with fifty solutions and your book ends up with the reviews to prove it.
SudokuPress builds puzzles the way newspaper syndicates do:
• First, a complete valid grid is filled.
• Then givens are DUG OUT in rotationally symmetric pairs — and after every single removal, an independent counter re-counts the solutions. The removal is kept only if the puzzle still has EXACTLY ONE.
• Digging stops at your difficulty target (Easy 40 givens, Medium 34, Hard 28) or at the point where nothing more can be removed without breaking uniqueness. The actual given-count is printed on every puzzle page — never hidden, never rounded.
• Before the book is written, every puzzle is re-counted one last time from its givens alone. Exactly one solution, matching the printed answers, or it doesn't ship.
You get a print-ready 8.5×11in PDF: clean bold-given puzzle pages labelled by difficulty, then full solution grids. Pick a seed and the same book rebuilds identically — series production without surprises. And it's fast: a 6-puzzle book generates and verifies in about a second; a 100-puzzle book is a coffee sip, not a coffee break.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Mixed test book: Easy 40 givens, Medium 33-34, Hard 27-29 — every puzzle re-proven unique-from-givens against its printed solution.
Desktop Sudoku makers sell at $37 to $197 one-time. SudokuPress is $29 once, proof included, 100% on your computer. Windows 10/11. A sample book is included so you can inspect the output first.
